We are regularly looking for enthusiastic logistics staff who are eager to roll up their sleeves and get to work. In this role, you may be assigned to various departments, and your responsibilities will include receiving, inspecting, and preparing products for shipment. Do you enjoy working in a dynamic environment where no two days are the same, and are you a true team player? If so, we’d love to get in touch with you—no strings attached. What’s your job about? Outbound Operations: What does your workday look like as an order picker or packer? You ensure that orders are prepared for shipment. As an order picker, you do this by filling boxes with the correct products. These boxes come your way on a conveyor belt. Using a handheld scanner, you scan the pick list and fill the box with the correct products from inventory. As a packer, you’re responsible for getting the order ready for shipment; you fill the box and attach a shipping label to it. Then you place the box back on the conveyor belt and move on to the next one! Inbound Duties As an Inbound Logistics Associate, you’ll work in the inbound departments where all medical supplies arrive. After the daily kick-off meeting with your team, the workday begins, and your tasks will include sorting incoming goods, recording the goods in the system, and moving them to the correct location in the warehouse. This is a full-time position. Workdays are Monday through Friday, and you’ll work two shifts. The work hours are from 6:00 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. and from 2:30 p.m. to 11:00 p.m. What skills do you have? You are comfortable working with computers and/or handheld scanners and are able to quickly master new systems; You have good spatial awareness and can quickly pick orders according to instructions. You are able to provide a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG); Sufficient command of spoken and written English due to safety instructions and communication on the work floor; Available full-time and willing to work extra hours

when needed. In short, are you the logistics employee who enjoys getting hands-on in the warehouse, with an eye for quality and safety? Then you’re a perfect fit for this position! You have own accommodation in Kerkrade area What do you get in return? Full-time position, 40 hours per week; Gross hourly wage between €15.25 and €15.80 (including a 7.5% shift differential); Travel allowance of €0.21 per kilometer (unlimited kilometers); A taxi service is available; Company fitness options (individual workouts and group classes); Excellent opportunities for career growth and development; Performance-based annual pay raise; Pension plan through Wiertz starting from the first week of employment; 13th month bonus.
